title: You Think Price Goes Up. Now What?
text: So, a location claim, as I mentioned before, is literally only one of the four, although it's probably the most common one for traders, right? They they say, "Well, I think something is going to go up." And then, by doing that, it's useful because if you think something is going to go up, it immediately cuts off like half of the structure universe that can make sense for what you're doing. So, again, remember, we're not approaching the problem set from "I think it's going to go up. Let me pick out of all of these different structures that exist, which one is best right out of the gate." And there's more filtering questions that help us naturally back into what makes sense.
